verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents the building blocks: usage event ingestion, single and batch, for usage-based billing, plus webhooks that fire on events. Neither shows real-time usage or accrued-cost visibility for customers or the team, and threshold alerts would have to be custom-built on top. Missing for 10: current-cycle usage and accrued-cost views or dashboards, customer-facing usage visibility, configurable usage/spend thresholds, pre-invoice alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
